scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the agent submits only the derived adsorption energies and diffusion barrier, not the raw DFT total energies; therefore we compare the reported values to the paper's reference with tolerances that account for code/pseudopotential variations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies, heights, and diffusion barrier from paper Table IV and text
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Phys. Rev. B 53, 4958 (1996) Table IV and text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the paper's reported computational results.

outputs.description: Adsorption energies and adatom heights for Al adatom on Al(111) at four high-symmetry sites.

Self-diffusion barrier for an isolated Al adatom on flat Al(111), computed as the energy difference between the minimum-energy adsorption site (determined from your computed site energies) and the saddle point (higher of bridge or fcc along the minimum-energy path).

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare reported values to hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances that account for differences in DFT implementation and pseudopotential.
